statements.query: MATCH (notebook:AWSSagemakerNotebookInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE notebook.exposed_internet IS NOT NULL WITH notebook LIMIT $LIMIT_SIZE REMOVE notebook.exposed_internet, notebook.exposed_internet_type, notebook.publicContext return COUNT(*) as TotalCompleted

statements.__comment: DirectInternetAccess = Enabled: the notebook reaches (and is reachable from) the internet through the SageMaker-managed network, outside the customer's VPC controls. Unknown (describe failed) is not flagged.
statements.query: MATCH (notebook:AWSSagemakerNotebookInstance)<-[:RESOURCE]-(:AWSAccount{id: $AWS_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:AWSOrganization{id: $ORGANIZATION_ID})<-[:OWNER]-(:CloudanixWorkspace{id: $WORKSPACE_ID}) WHERE notebook.direct_internet_access = 'Enabled' SET notebook.exposed_internet = true, notebook.exposed_internet_type = ['direct_internet_access'], notebook.publicContext = apoc.convert.toJson([{resource: notebook.arn, resourceType: 'aws-ai-sagemaker-instance', context: [{notebookArn: notebook.arn, notebookName: notebook.name, status: notebook.status, url: notebook.url, directInternetAccess: notebook.direct_internet_access, exposureTypes: ['direct_internet_access']}]}])

name: aws SageMaker notebook instance internet exposure
